title: Moon Mystery
provenance: Reported by Swiss-Mac-User (highball#381, highball#382, highball-db#547, 2026-10-18), Apple M5 Pro, macOS 27.2, Highball 0.10.19, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28: works on DXMT (one crash when a Steam achievement triggered, not repeatable, and Steam's overlay FPS counter drawn as a black square), rated 4 of 5 on D3DMetal (resolution capped at 1440 pixels, low graphics forced), and DXVK crashes when a save loads (a pipeline with a geometry shader fails to compile in MoltenVK). Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Works on DXMT, the default mode, with full graphics. D3DMetal caps the resolution and forces low settings, and DXVK crashes when loading a game, so keep DXMT.

knownIssues.symptom: Crash when loading a game on DXVK
knownIssues.cause: a render pipeline with a geometry shader fails to compile in MoltenVK (Metal has no geometry shaders)

knownIssues.symptom: Resolution capped at 1440 pixels and low graphics forced on D3DMetal
Steam overlay's FPS counter shows a black square
